map.养殖存栏量估算（面积×密度） 使用指南: Livestock inventory estimator (area x density) user guide
map.输入养殖面积、存栏密度与平均体重，快速估算总存栏数量、总生物量及单位面积产量。: Input farming area, inventory density and average weight to quickly estimate total headcount, total biomass and per-area yield.
map.存栏数 = 面积 × 存栏密度 × 单位换算 × 成活率%；总生物量 = 存栏数: Headcount = area x inventory density x unit conversion x survival rate%; total biomass = headcount x average weight; converted density = headcount / area
map.面积先按所选单位归一到平方米（亩 ÷ 666.67、ha ÷ 10 000、㎡: Area first normalized to square meters by the chosen unit (mu / 666.67, ha / 10,000, m^2 direct), times inventory density for theoretical headcount, times survival rate for actual headcount. Total biomass is headcount x average weight; and convert headcount to "head/m^2" and "head/mu" for horizontal comparison, aiding farm capacity and feed-support planning.
map.存栏 = 圈舍面积 × 设计密度（头/㎡）。: Inventory = barn area x design density (head/m^2).
map.用于圈舍验收与粪污配套核算。: For barn acceptance and manure-support accounting.
map.：猪舍 500 m²，育肥期密度 0.8 头/㎡，存栏 = 500 × 0.8: : pig barn 500 m^2, finishing density 0.8 head/m^2, headcount = 500 x 0.8 = 400 head. If higher density 1.0 head/m^2 holds 500 head, but verify ventilation and manure-treatment margin.
map.连作障碍指数（土壤病原菌积累）估算: Continuous-cropping obstacle index (soil pathogen accumulation) estimation
map.短期增存栏，但过密增病死、降日增重与饲料转化率，综合效益可能反降。应算『单位面积: Short-term inventory increase, but over-density raises disease/death, lowers daily gain and feed conversion; overall benefit may drop. Compute "profit per area" not "head count".
map.存栏决定粪污产生量（头·日），据此定沼气池/储粪池容积与消纳地面积，密度翻倍则处: Inventory determines manure output (head-day), thus the biogas pit / manure tank volume and land area for disposal; doubling density doubles the treatment scale.
